Esthetician Front Desk Concierge Insights Contact Book now Medical Aesthetics and Next-Level Facials and Skincare About Tryst Located just minutes south of Boston at 29 Main Street, Hingham, MA, Tryst is an award-winning skincare destination offering next level facial services and medical aesthetics under one roof—including HydraFacial, Dermaplaning, laser hair removal , and neurotoxin and filler injections . Medical aesthetic services are provided through a separate physician-owned medical practice at this location. Your visit to Tryst is an experience like no other—combining ultimate relaxation with goal-oriented, effective skincare therapies. Make An Appointment Cutting-edge therapies Advanced Skincare Tryst offers advanced esthetics services to help you achieve your skincare goals and be confident and comfortable in your own skin. Committed to using safe and high quality products, top-of-the-line technology, and staying up-to-date with the latest advancements in skincare, Tryst’s team of professional estheticians provide you exceptional care. View All Services Founder & Salon Owner Kelly O'Keefe Kelly O’Keefe founded the salon in April 2012, inspired by years of work as an award-winning wedding makeup artist, and she leads the salon’s non-medical services and client experience. Tryst’s full menu of services has grown along with its client base to include meticulous brow-shaping, brow and lash lifts and tints, waxing and hair removal, lashes, facials, cutting-edge skincare technologies, and sunless tanning. Medical aesthetic services are provided by Main Esthetics, PC, owned and operated by Howard Kesselman, M.D. Meet the Tryst Team Meet Our Skincare Experts The Tryst Team Tryst owner Kelly O’Keefe has cultivated a team of professionals so passionate about beauty that they live and breathe what they do and celebrate the process of bringing out the very best in their clients in every service they provide. Nurse Practitioner Elizabeth L. Taylor, NP Elizabeth Larsen Taylor, FNP-C , is a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner with over 30 years of clinical experience. Following a distinguished career in Critical Care and Cardiology, she transitioned into aesthetic medicine to pursue her lifelong passion for helping individuals look and feel their best. Liz received her initial aesthetic training from the Aesthetic Institute of Massachusetts in 2021, where she gained foundational expertise in neurotoxins, dermal fillers, collagen induction therapy, and more. Committed to continuous learning, she has since completed numerous advanced courses, firmly believing that ongoing education leads to superior outcomes. In addition to her aesthetic work, Liz brings extensive experience in medical weight management, particularly in the use of peptides. She is an active member of both the International Peptide Society and the American Academy of Anti-Aging Medicine (A4M), reflecting her dedication to evidence-based, patient-centered care. Her holistic approach—nurturing both internal health and external appearance—embodies her belief that true wellness stems from the harmony between body and mind. Known for her warm, approachable demeanor and clinical expertise, Liz is a trusted provider and expert nurse injector whose treatment plans are grounded in both compassion and precision. We are proud to have Liz lead the Tryst Medical Aesthetic team, where her leadership and vision continue to elevate the patient experience. Master Esthetician Tayla Tayla is a Master Esthetician and senior team member at Tryst. A brow guru and expert facialist, she has also added Master HydraFacialist to her resume. Tayla specializes in Microneedling and Laser Hair Removal, delivering results-driven treatments with a gentle, confident touch. Her strong following of loyal clients speaks to both her expertise and the trust she’s earned in her craft. Master Esthetician Lindsay Lindsay is a Master Esthetician and one of our resident brow gurus—delivering a perfect brow with every client. In addition to her extensive education as a makeup artist, Lindsay is a trained HydraFacial provider and also specializes in Microneedling and Laser Hair Removal. Her goal is to make sure every client feels their best, each and every visit. esthetician Lauryn An absolute perfectionist, Lauryn loves building connections, sharing knowledge and truly listening to client concerns. Her goal with each client is to have them leave 100% satisfied. Lauryn is a graduate of Elizabeth Grady and brings to Tryst a multi-certified esthetic license in advanced esthetics. esthetician Abby Abby became an esthetician to help others look and feel their best. She loves creating a relaxing and caring environment for her clients, ensuring they leave feeling rejuvenated and pampered. Abby’s favorite service to provide is facials, where she excels at bringing out the natural radiance in her clients’ skin. esthetician Taylor Taylor is a driven and talented esthetician who loves helping people feel great about their skin. She’s always learning about the latest skincare trends and knows how to get the best results for each person she works with. Her friendly and approachable personality makes clients feel at ease the moment they walk through the door. Esthetician Sam Sam is dedicated to making her clients feel comfortable and welcomed the moment they walk in. A graduate of the Master Esthetics Program at Catherine Hinds, Sam hopes to help clients achieve their skincare goals through a combination of advanced techniques with high-quality products. Front Desk Concierge & Spray Tan Artist Callie Callie brings over two years of experience—and a whole lot of warmth and energy—to every appointment. She genuinely loves connecting with clients and finds true joy in helping people feel confident in their own skin. Known for her friendly, approachable style, Callie delivers a comfortable, customized tanning experience tailored perfectly to your skin tone and type. Medspa Concierge Katie Katie has a true passion for creating a seamless and elevated client experience, ensuring every guest feels valued, comfortable, and cared for from the moment they arrive.
